hypotheses.B0_native_replay_is_exact: Maximum native replay logit error is at most 0.02.
hypotheses.B1_semantics_beats_mean_write: The correctly bound semantic write beats the mean write by at least 0.05 in both full-logit and signed CE-effect fidelity.
hypotheses.B2_semantics_beats_permuted_binding: The correctly bound semantic write beats the p95 of 32 row-permuted semantic predictions by at least 0.05 in both metrics.
hypotheses.B3_joint_semantics_beats_single_role_lab: The joint current/next/position semantic prediction beats the better of current-only and next-only predictions by at least 0.05 full-logit fidelity.
hypotheses.B4_correct_binding_closes_material_remai: Relative to the mean write, correct semantic binding closes at least 25% of the remaining full-logit fidelity gap.
hypotheses.B5_write_r2_and_finite_rank_controls_agr: The ordering mean, current-only, next-only, and joint semantic is identical under observational write R2 and finite full-logit fidelity.
